Capabilities.title: One partner from documentation to finished product
Capabilities.description: Send us your documentation. We source components, assemble, test and ship the finished product. No handovers, no second supplier, no gaps in responsibility.

assembly.title: Complete PCB assembly
assembly.description: SMT and THT assembly, component sourcing, final assembly and logistics. Up to five million components per month.

production.title: From prototype to series production
production.description: A single validation unit and a run of half a million use the same production lines, process controls and documentation standards.

testing.title: In-house test engineering
testing.description: AOI, X-ray, ICT and functional testing. We design and build test fixtures around your product, not the other way around.

Cookies.preferencesDescription: Choose which services we may use during your visit. Optional services start only with your permission. You can change your choices later.
Cookies.necessaryDescription: These remember your choices on future visits and when you switch languages. They are needed to save your settings, so they always stay active.
Cookies.analyticsDescription: These show us how much our website is used and how quickly it loads. They help us improve its content and how it works. You can allow each service separately.
Cookies.consentPurpose: Remembers your cookie preferences for your next visit.
